name: Blood Elves ride and buy mounts in Brill, Draenei in Darnassus (#7615)
contract: Blood Elves start in Deathknell and Draenei in Shadowglen, so their home riding trainers and mount vendors are
the Forsaken and Night Elf ones. Velma Warnam (4773) and Jartsam (4753) open the riding trainer window with
Novice Riding (33379) available, and Zachariah Post (4731) and Lelanai (4730) open their mount shelves, without
Exalted reputation. Other races still need Exalted: an Orc gets no buy option from Zachariah Post.

steps.label: the Blood Elf right-clicks Velma Warnam

steps.text: I seek training to ride a steed.
steps.label: Velma offers riding training to a Blood Elf
the Blood Elf chooses riding training
Novice Riding is available to the Blood Elf
the Blood Elf right-clicks Zachariah Post

steps.text: I would like to buy from you.
steps.label: Zachariah offers his shelves to a Blood Elf
the Blood Elf chooses to buy
the Blood Elf receives Zachariah's vendor list
the Red Skeletal Horse is on sale to the Blood Elf
the Draenei right-clicks Jartsam

steps.text: I seek training to ride a steed.
steps.label: Jartsam offers riding training to a Draenei
the Draenei chooses riding training
Novice Riding is available to the Draenei
the Draenei right-clicks Lelanai

steps.text: I would like to buy from you.
steps.label: Lelanai offers her shelves to a Draenei
the Draenei chooses to buy
the Draenei receives Lelanai's vendor list
the Striped Nightsaber is on sale to the Draenei
the Orc right-clicks Zachariah Post
an Orc below Exalted with Undercity still gets no buy option
